items.name: VLCC newbuilding contract with Hanwha Ocean
items.claim: In June 2026, DHT Holdings entered into an agreement with Hanwha Ocean Co., Ltd. for the construction of a VLCC scheduled for delivery in August 2028.
items.source_excerpt: In June 2026, the Company entered into an agreement with Hanwha Ocean Co., Ltd. for the construction of a VLCC. The vessel is scheduled for delivery in August 2028 and will be a sister of the two vessels the Company took delivery of in the first quarter of 2026.
